observations: Photo 0 shows a used engine and gearbox assembly standing upright on dirt ground, oily and dusty, with a watermark reading CHIDI AUTOS VENTURE.
Photo 1 shows the same assembly from the side with a person working near it; no readable brand plate is visible.
Photo 2 shows the gearbox bell housing and engine block from another angle; still no readable Mercedes badge or model number.
A red motorcycle and a white car are visible in the background of photo 0.

claims.claim: Engine and gearbox Mercedes benz for G L
claims.evidence: No readable Mercedes badge or model plate in photos 0, 1, or 2; seller text alone is not proof.

risks.risk: The assembly may not run or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking or running, or a compression/leak-down test.

risks.risk: It may not be a Mercedes or may not fit a GL.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine number or identification plate.
risks.if_unproven: as an unverified generic engine and gearbox

risks.risk: Internal gearbox or engine wear cannot be seen externally.
Ancillaries or sensors may be missing.
risks.proof: Detailed photo showing all attached components.

proof_requests: Close-up of any engine block casting numbers or identification plate.
Video of the engine cranking or running.
Photos showing all sensors, injectors, and ancillaries still attached.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used engine and gearbox assembly even without a readable model, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working and unverified brand.
